prompt.text:
Implement a framework-free CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ buildMenu, selectMenuItem }`. `buildMenu(records)` requires an array. Every record must be a plain object with a non-empty string `id`, a non-empty string `title`, and a string `description`; surrounding whitespace is removed from all three fields. Duplicate normalized ids throw `RangeError`, and malformed records throw `TypeError`. Preserve input order and return fresh rows shaped `{ key, label, detail, selected }`, with selected initially false. `selectMenuItem(rows, key)` requires a valid rows array and a non-empty string key. It returns a fresh array of fresh row objects in the same order, setting selected true only for the row whose key exactly equals the supplied key and false for all others. If no key matches, all rows are unselected. Empty arrays are valid. Neither function may mutate or alias its inputs.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
